sources.entry: Build a Full Stack Movie Voting App with Test-First Development using Mocha, React, Redux and Immutable

summary.title: Full-Stack Redux Tutorial
summary.one_liner: You learn how to build a test-first full-stack voting app with a Node/Redux/Immutable.js server and a React/Redux client, communicating over Socket.io.
keywords: how to use immutable js with redux
takeaways: Design a Redux application state tree (entries, vote pair, tallies, winner) before writing code.
Use Immutable.js Lists and Maps to write pure, non-mutating state update functions tested with Mocha and Chai.
Set up a Node project with Babel ES2015, Mocha test scripts, and chai-immutable.
See how the server and client communicate by message passing over Socket.io, with a React UI and Redux middleware on the client.
summary.summary: This long-form tutorial walks through building a live voting app from scratch, with a Node Redux server and a React Redux client that talk over WebSockets. It starts by designing the application state tree, then sets up the project with Babel, Mocha, Chai and Immutable.js. It teaches immutability with small learning tests before writing pure reducer-style logic such as setEntries, next, and vote, all developed test-first. The page excerpt ends before the Socket.io, React, and middleware sections, which the table of contents lists.
